title: 遗忘看似进步：流式说话人日志适配中的指标掩盖与排练代价
summary: 研究小数据适配对流式说话人日志系统的影响，发现适配虽提升域内检测性能，却损害说话人身份的时间一致性，且排练虽减少退化但降低跨域迁移能力。
summary_en: This paper studies small-data adaptation in a streaming diarizer, finding that adaptation improves in-domain detection but degrades temporal identity consistency, and rehearsal reduces degradation at the cost of cross-domain transfer.
